nodes.summary: The LD score of marker `j` with respect to annotation `C`: `ℓ(j, C) = ∑_k a_{kC} r_jk²` (Finucane et al. 2015 for binary annotations; Gazal et al. 2017 for continuous ones).
nodes.title: Annotation LD score of a marker

nodes.summary: The `N`-normalized score `β̂ j = X_jᵀ y / N` of marker `j` (as in `LDScore.Model.betaHat`).
nodes.title: Normalized marker score in stratified LD-score regression

nodes.summary: The heritability `h²(C) = ∑_{k ∈ C} σ²_k` of category `C`, for a labeling `cat` of the markers by categories.
nodes.title: Heritability of a marker category

nodes.summary: The number `M_C` of markers in category `C`.
nodes.title: Number of markers in a category

nodes.summary: The stratified statistic of `ofLDScore D` is the statistic of `LDScore`.
nodes.title: Stratified statistic agrees with the LD-score statistic

nodes.summary: The association statistic `χ² j = N * β̂ j ^ 2` of marker `j`.
nodes.title: Association chi-squared statistic in stratified LD-score regression

nodes.summary: The design matrix `[1 | N ℓ(·, C)]` of stratified LD-score regression with a free intercept; column `none` is the intercept and column `some C` the scaled annotation LD score.
nodes.title: Design matrix of stratified LD-score regression

nodes.summary: The enrichment of category `C`: its proportion of heritability divided by its proportion of markers, `(h²(C) / h²) / (M_C / M)` with `h² = ∑_k σ²_k` (Finucane et al. 2015).
nodes.title: Heritability enrichment of a category

nodes.summary: A real matrix has injective `mulVec` iff it has full column rank.
nodes.title: Injective matrix action iff full column rank

nodes.summary: Under the annotation model, the vector of expected statistics is the design matrix applied to the parameter vector `(σ²_e, τ)` (intercept first). Hence the parameters are determined by the expected statistics of all markers, whatever their values, iff `(design X a).rank = Fintype.card (Option ι)` (`injective_mulVec_iff_rank_eq_card`).
nodes.title: Expected statistics are the design matrix times the parameters

nodes.summary: Frequency-dependent architecture (the α model of Schoech et al. 2019): if the per-allele effect variance of marker `k` with allele frequency `p_k` is proportional to `[p_k (1 - p_k)]^α`, the variance of the effect of the standardized genotype is `σ²_k = c [p_k (1 - p_k)]^(1 + α)`, and then, for a standardized genotype matrix and `N ≠ 0`, `𝔼[χ² j] = N c ∑_k [p_k (1 - p_k)]^(1 + α) r_jk² + σ²_e`. (The real power is…
nodes.title: Frequency-dependent architecture

nodes.summary: Stratified LD-score regression (Finucane et al. 2015; continuous annotations, Gazal et al. 2017): if the per-marker variances are linear in the annotations, `σ²_k = ∑_C τ_C a_{kC}`, then for a standardized genotype matrix and `N ≠ 0`, `𝔼[χ² j] = N ∑_C τ_C ℓ(j, C) + σ²_e`.
nodes.title: Stratified LD-score regression

nodes.summary: For a column with sum of squares `N` (a standardized marker) and `N ≠ 0`: `𝔼[χ² j] = N ∑_k r_jk² σ²_k + σ²_e`.
nodes.title: Expected chi-squared statistic of a standardized marker

nodes.summary: Expected statistic with per-marker variances, for an arbitrary genotype matrix: `𝔼[χ² j] = N ∑_k r_jk² σ²_k + σ²_e (∑_i X_ij²) / N`. (For `N = 0` both sides are `0`.)
nodes.title: Expected statistic with per-marker variances

nodes.summary: The random-effects model of stratified LD-score regression at the level of raw second moments: marker `k` has effect variance `sigma2 k`, the noise has variance `sigmaE2`, and effects and noise are orthogonal in `L²`. As in `LDScore.Model`, the measure is arbitrary, no means are assumed, and all statements are conditional on the genotype matrix.
nodes.title: Random-effects model of stratified LD-score regression

nodes.summary: The LD-score regression model of `LDScore` is the stratified model with equal per-marker variances `h² / M` and noise variance `1 - h²`.
nodes.title: LD-score regression model as a stratified model
Phenotype in the stratified LD-score model

nodes.summary: LDSC-SEG contrast (Finucane et al. 2018): for per-SNP variances `σ²_k = ∑_C τ_C a_{kC}`, two SNPs `k`, `k'` whose annotations agree except on annotation `cS` differ in per-SNP variance by `τ_{cS} (a_{k cS} - a_{k' cS})`. With `cS` the indicator of a gene set `S` contained in the control gene set `G` (whose indicator is one of the other annotations), `k ∈ S` and `k' ∈ G ∖ S` with equal values of all other…
nodes.title: LDSC-SEG contrast

nodes.summary: For a partition of the markers into categories (a labeling `cat`) and nonzero total heritability, the marker-proportion-weighted enrichments sum to one: `∑_C (M_C / M) * Enrichment(C) = 1`. Empty categories contribute `0` on both sides of each term.
nodes.title: Marker-proportion-weighted enrichments sum to one

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
